header.title: P.Oxy. 86 5543: Magical Formulary: AI translation (Claude)
header.author: Greek magical papyri and amulets
header.source: Translated by Claude (claude-opus-5-5, Anthropic) from the library's urn:magic:dclp:976536:grc, from papyri.info's Digital Corpus of Literary Papyri (CC BY 3.0), one English line for each line of the original. notes.3: Every line is broken at both ends. 'Co[...]' renders a word beginning συν-, sense lost. ἧλον read as 'nail'. Koura is probably Kore (Persephone). The text marks προσαγ*γελ as a problem reading. 'NN' renders ἡ δ(ε)ῖ(να), 'so-and-so' (a woman), where the client's name is to be inserted. αὐτῷ in line 4 could be 'in it' or 'to him'.

nodes.text: [...]. on the ground; and if [she] stops, co[...]
[...]. a nail and a hair of the wo[man] [...]
[...].. for three days, speak [the spell] over [...]
[...]en NN, and she no longer went in .[...]
